name: Alpenflora
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The **Gasthof Alpenflora** in Ischgl, Tyrol, is located in a quiet side location just five minutes' walk from the town center. The rooms are furnished with local wood and feature a balcony. The restaurant serves regional cuisine alongside international dishes. The wellness area includes a **sauna** and a steam bath. The Silvretta Railway is reachable within a few minutes on foot. In summer, the establishment serves as a starting point for **hikes**, while in winter, it offers ski trips. The stay is offered with **half-board**.
